## Professional Summary

Senior Data Scientist with over 11 years of experience designing and implementing analytical systems to measure program impact and guide strategic initiatives. Proven leader in architecting data collection systems, conducting rigorous causal inference and machine learning analyses, and mentoring teams to build robust, production-grade tools. An adept collaborator on interdisciplinary teams, dedicated to translating complex data into actionable, equity-focused insights for diverse stakeholders.


## Experience

### Senior Data Scientist {.job-title}
**Pierce County Finance, Research and Data Analysis** | Tacoma, WA | *March 2022 – Present*

::: {.job-description}
- Led the end-to-end design of a new data infrastructure for Pierce County's $30M behavioral health portfolio, centralizing data for over 18,000 clients and 90,000+ services. Architected data collection protocols, specified ETL enhancements for engineering teams, and developed a comprehensive quality assurance codebase.
- Authored a comprehensive evaluation of contracting workflows to address processing delays. Using panel regression with fixed effects, I isolated the drivers of bottlenecks and delivered seven actionable recommendations to improve efficiency without increasing headcount.
- Developed a geospatial unsupervised clustering algorithm and built an interactive mapping application to guide the placement of mobile opioid treatment units for program managers.
- Supervised and mentored two analysts, guiding the adoption of Git, distributed workflows, and functional programming, and collaborated on devising the team's professional development goals for 2025.
- Conducted a council-mandated analysis of senior services funding to support data-informed decision-making for the 2026-27 county budget.
:::

### Data Scientist {.job-title}
**University of Washington, Center for Education Data and Research** | Seattle, WA | *June 2018 – December 2021*

::: {.job-description}
- Ideated and led a team to create a novel, real-time dataset by scraping job postings from school district websites. This asset, which I built using Python and Selenium, has provided the foundation for at least five publications and proved vital for analyzing workforce challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic.
- Co-authored the first peer-reviewed study on Washington's school nurse workforce, using probabilistic record linkage and regression modeling to evaluate how student access to care varied by race and socioeconomic status.
- Published peer-reviewed research analyzing online education enrollment trends using a fixed-effects Poisson model.
- Analyzed a randomized controlled trial using a randomized block design to assess student teaching outcomes.
:::

### Data Analyst {.job-title}
**University of Washington, Center for Education Data and Research** | Seattle, WA | *September 2014 – May 2018*

::: {.job-description}
- Managed and modeled complex administrative and ad hoc datasets, contributing to over 10 peer-reviewed publications with more than 575 citations.
- Applied causal inference methods, specifically difference-in-differences, to evaluate the impact of financial aid programs, resulting in three peer-reviewed publications.
- Promoted to a higher-level role that oversaw research projects from ideation to completion in June of 2018.
:::
